newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion down near close on world trends.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion down near close on world trends.

text.p: Gold and silver prices opened lower on the back of overnight losses in the world market and dipped further towards the close amid slow physical buying, dealers said on Wednesday.
On Tuesday gold was down by 15 rupees per 10 gramme while silver was up by 30 rupees per kg.

"Arrivals of the imported precious metals however remained at low ebb but physical buyers kept to the sidelines expecting further price erosion in the local market looking at the fresh drop in the world market," they said.

Meanwhile prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) settled 300 rupees lower at 55,600 rupees each. They were down 200 rupees each on Tuesday and by 100 rupees each on Monday. Biscuit prices fell by 500 rupees per piece last week.
